_doc: Audio per map stage (systems/valley.ts valleyStage variant; 'default' = a map with one look). arrangement 'thin' plays the season piece thinned (music_src.py piece 'thin') over the dry wind with a bird now and then; a stage on the dry palette is thin unless it says 'full'. water: beds that run on this stage; 'near' rects [x, y, w, h] (tiles) make it positional (louder near the water, never under 'floor' of its level), none = the same everywhere; 'gain' scales the bed; 'wait' names a stat that must be set first (the reveal that shows the water sets it).
